text: 近日，多家商业地产机构相继发布2026年第三季度上海房地产市场报告。数据均显示，上海商业地产市场延续需求修复与产业升级共振的态势：办公楼市场需求回暖、零售物业活跃度提升、投资市场前三季度累计交易总额同比双位数增长。（澎湃新闻）
text_en: Recently, several commercial real estate agencies published their reports on Shanghai's real estate market for the third quarter of 2026. The data all show that Shanghai's commercial real estate market continues to see demand recovery and industrial upgrading reinforce each other: demand in the office market is picking up, activity in retail properties is increasing, and the investment market's total transaction value in the first three quarters grew by double digits year on year. (The Paper)
